ns2:section.sectionText: Honors Section 25 is for students registered in CS 225 Data Structures This course will be taught synchronously online for Fall 2020. Lectures will be recorded. Each semester, CS 225 offers a one credit hour honors section that covers an advanced topic in CS related to data structures (offered as CS 296, Section 25). This is the honors component to receive James Scholar or HCLA credit for CS 225. As an honors course, CS 296 will be much less structured than CS 225 and requires significant independent work and learning. This semester, CS 296 will focus on algorithms and data structures used to process sequences of characters (string data) and their use in large-scale data collections. Topics will include string search, string data structures, inexact matching, and sketching data structures. While heavily motivated by Big Data problems in genomics, no knowledge of biology is assumed. Assignments and projects will be done primarily in C++.
